TargetWriteCertificate.restored_row_certificate {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (w : List (Gate n)) (hraw : raw w = identity n)
  (hpos : 0 < targetCount y w) :
  (∃ first, donors y w = first :: retainedDonors y w) ∧
    (retainedDonors y w).length = targetCount y w - 1 ∧
      ∀ (r : Fin n),
        (reducedCoefficients y w r).length = (retainedDonors y w).length ∧
          combination (retainedDonors y w) (reducedCoefficients y w r) = rowXor (identity n r) (projected y w r)
TargetWriteCertificate.restored_at_most_certificate {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (w : List (Gate n))
  (hraw : raw w = identity n) (hpos : 0 < targetCount y w) :
  ∃ G C,
    (∃ first, donors y w = first :: G) ∧
      G.length ≤ targetCount y w - 1 ∧
        ∀ (r : Fin n), (C r).length = G.length ∧ combination G (C r) = rowXor (identity n r) (projected y w r)
TargetWriteCertificate.row_generation {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (w : List (Gate n)) (r : Fin n) :
  ((scan y w).coefficients r).length = (donors y w).length ∧
    combination (donors y w) ((scan y w).coefficients r) = defect (raw w) (projected y w) r
TargetWriteCertificate.prefix_row_generation {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (w : List (Gate n)) (t : Nat) (r : Fin n) :
  ((scan y (List.take t w)).coefficients r).length = (donors y (List.take t w)).length ∧
    combination (donors y (List.take t w)) ((scan y (List.take t w)).coefficients r) =
      defect (raw (List.take t w)) (projected y (List.take t w)) r
TargetWriteCertificate.donors_target_snoc {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (u : List (Gate n)) (g : Gate n) (h : g.dst = y) :
  donors y (u ++ [g]) = donors y u ++ [raw u g.src]
TargetWriteCertificate.zero_target_projected_eq_raw {n : Nat} (y : Fin n) (w : List (Gate n))
  (hzero : targetCount y w = 0) : projected y w = raw w
